notes.title: Patch Notes - New Balance Adjustment
notes.content:
In consideration of the current state of the game, the following balance adjustments will be implemented on December 16th. 

[h3][list][*] [b]Adjustments to balance the rate at which all Survivors are defeated.[/b][/list][/h3]We've confirmed that the balance in the victory rate between Survivors and Raiders is largely consistent with our intended design based on the recent data outlined above.

However, since the rate at which the Survivor team is being defeated is slightly high, we're implementing the following adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/61910a707924cef5187f693be073dfeb685ffc9d.png[/img]

◆ [u]Adjustments to the Escape Time Machine[/u]

- Slightly increased the rate at which the gauge to call the escape time machine fills up.
- Increased the number of escape time machine beacons that appear during the Search Phase when the number of remaining Survivors decreases.

[h3][list][*][b]Adjustments to lessen the victory rate discrepancy between different Raiders.[/b][/list][/h3]Out of the three Raiders, Cell's rate of victory is still slightly lower. In order to improve this, we will implement the following adjustments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/e1b43263764a0911e37d9748bc52dc90331a0217.png[/img]

◆ [u]Adjustments to the Raider "Cell"[/u]

- Decreased the amount of evolution gauge required to progress from evolution level 3 to level 4.
- Increased the amount of evolution energy gained when Cell's Passive Skill "Life Absorption" is powered up.
 
We appreciate for your patience and understanding.

[h3][b]Thank you for your continued support of DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Latest Game Improvements
notes.content:
The following is a description of fixes that were performed to address various in-game issues during the November 14th maintenance.

[h3][b]■ Improved Contents ■[/b][/h3]
[u]Matching[/u]
・Matches did not progress past the versus screen on certain platforms
・The UI did not display immediately after a match began in ONLINE MATCH and other communication errors occurred.
・If connection was lost due to "8/8 Establishing the connection" after a match began, the remaining members would be unable to use the cancel function.

[u]During Battle[/u]
・There were instances where Survivors were unable to summon Shenron after Raider "Cell" or "Frieza" launched an Ultimate Super Attack
・If a Survivor received an attack at the same time they used the Active Skill "Capsule (Single-Wheel Motorbike)", sometimes the bike remaind on the stage, and the Survivor no longer responded to certain commands.
・There were instances in which players lost their abilities when using a Senzu Bean in PRACTICE MODE on certain platforms
・If the Raider's dialog played at the same time as Trunks', no further dialog would be played for the Raider
・If Piccolo's Super Attack "Evil Explosion" was immediately followed up with multiple Ki Blasts, the Raider would no longer receive damage after the second hit
・An issue in which the spectator camera would not return to the viewpoint of the player's character.
・An issue in which players were revived while still spectating other teammates
・The player could no longer be revived after another player stopped the revival process just as the revive gauge reached MAX
・If a player evaded while using certain Skills (such as the Grappling Device), they would begin to move at random

[u]Other[/u]
・BREAKERS POINTS intended for use in linked Xenoverse 2 accounts were not valid

[h3][b]■ Other Adjustments ■[/b][/h3]
・The installation progress for power keys is now retained even if a player cancels in the middle of the installation
　*This has been done to help against Raiders camping near the location.
　　In order to balance battles, we plan to add something to increase the Raiders' strength in the future
・On the Steam version, a key assign category was added so that the Map/Menu during battle can be opened with Enter+an optional key
・Even if you do not complete all of the daily and weekly challenges that are displayed, the subsequent challenges will now be displayed
・Fixed other minor bugs

[h3][b]■ Content to be adjusted in future ■[/b][/h3]
・Change in specification where the next challenges will be updated even if all daily/weekly challenges are not completed within specific period. 

We appreciate for your patience and understanding. 

[h3][b]Thank you for your continued support of DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes - About Various Adjustments
notes.content:
[h3][b]■ Concept of Balance Adjustment ■[/b][/h3]
In response to the results of the beta test before launch, there were many various game balance adjustments while keeping the overwhelming power of Raider and importantly considering that many Survivors can enjoy the game as well. In the past, we have adjusted such as increasing the overall Survivor survival rate, decreasing the Raider defeat rate, increasing the Super Time Machine activation rate and many other adjustments. 

Currently, we are observing survivability rate and Raider defeat rate have been increasing as the playing skills of Survivor have been improving since the game launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/feac579dcff3e9cfa83dc8ea8c6aabbed35b9c4c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/ab4ce520b0456a5f66e840969fca427d5d3607bd.png[/img]

Therefore, the following adjustments are scheduled to be reflected this week on [b]11/11 4am CET | 11/10 7pm PST[/b]. 

[h3][b]■ Breakdown of Adjustments ■[/b][/h3]
1. Raised evolution speed of Raider "Cell"
　⇒There were many cases where Cell's naturally fast evolution speed could not be taken advantage of, so his evolution speed has been raised across the board.

2. Lowered Raider "Majin Buu" level 1 evolution parameters
　⇒As this Raider had an advantage even at level 1, Majin Buu's parameters have been adjusted to be more in line with the game's concept.

3. Adjusted to reduce the chances of the Survivor team being defeated early in a match 
　⇒The likelihood of Survivors to remain alive at low transformation levels was found to vary dramatically depending on each player's individual ability, so the overall game balance has been adjusted accordingly.

[h3][b]■ Raised Evolution Speed of Raider "Cell" ■[/b][/h3]
・Slightly buffed the Passive Skill "Life Absorption".
・Slightly buffed the Passive Skill "Auto-Evolve".
・In accordance with the above, adjusted the gauge amount needed to evolve as well as the rate at which the gauge increases.
 
[b]■ Lowered Raider "Majin Buu" Level 1 Evolution Parameters ■[/b]
・Lowered Ki Blast speed, hit detection width, attack range, and damage.

[b]■ Adjustments to Reduce the Chances of the Survivor Team Being Defeated Early in a Match ■[/b]
・Slightly reduced damage taken while in transformation level 1 and 2.
・Reduced the time required to recharge the Passive Skill "Barrier Auto-Recovery".
　Since the time to recover has been reduced at the base level, the percentage increase from training has been reduced.

[h3][b]■ Adjusted Various Other Skills ■[/b][/h3]
・Increased the cooldown for "Capsule (Single-Wheel Motorbike)".
・Increased the cooldown time for "Grappling Device".
・Reduced the cooldown time for "Saiyan Pod Remote".

We will continue to monitor the changes in the environment such as based on the addition of transpheres and make overall balance adjustments.

[h3][b]Thank you for your continued support of DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes - In Regards of Adjustment on Majin Buu
notes.content:
Thank you for playing DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS. 
We would like to inform you of the adjustments we have made based on gameplay conditions and feedback. 

■ Main revision on Majin Buu
◆Active Skill "Go-Go Gum"
The skill "Go-Go Gum" is designed to be released when hit by melee attacks, super attacks and other attacks that cause the players to roll over or blow away.  It is not released by the damage of Ki Blasts. 
However, as a result, by attacking with Ki Blast immediately after the bind, more damage than expected was caused; therefore, the following adjustments have been made.

・Shortened the bind time of the active skill "Go-Go Gum".

◆Passive skill "Majin Buu Resurrection"
Currently, when the first form "Spopovich" super attack, melee attack, and active skill "Summon Yamu" are successfully utilized and the bonus of increased evolution energy is added, it was possible to evolve to the second stage "Majin Buu (Innocent)" by simply finishing off one Survivor during the Dragon Change. Since this was not the original design, the following adjustments were made.

・Adjusted of the amount of evolution energy increase
・Decreased the amount of evolution energy increased by the super attack "Energy Drain."
・Slightly decreased the amount of evolution energy increased by the active skill "Summon Yamu.
・Slightly decreased the amount of evolution energy increased by melee attacks.
・Slightly decreased the amount of increase in the effect of skill enhancements.

We will continue to update this title after its release to meet the expectations of our fans.
We look forward to your continued support of DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS.

notes.title: Prepare yourselves, Survivors!
notes.content:
[h2][b]The Mighty Lord Frieza[/b] will reveal his true power in [b]DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS[/b], releasing on [b]October 14, 2022[/b]![/h2]

Taking place in the [b]DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE universe[/b], DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS will pit a team of [b]seven Survivors[/b] trying to escape [b]one Raider[/b]. The Raider,  one of the [i][b]major antagonists[/b][/i] from the franchise, will have to use their overwhelming power and increasingly powerful evolutions to [b]hunt and defeat the Survivors[/b]. 

Survivors are [b]regular civilians[/b] that have been caught in a [b]“Temporal Seam”[/b], trapping them in a place where space and time are in disarray. The main objective of Survivors is to [b]escape the Temporal Seam[/b] using various gadgets, the most valuable of which are [b]Transpheres[/b], that contain the souls of Super warriors and [b]grant special abilities and powers[/b] when used.

[h3]In this dangerous environment that Survivors share with the Raider, the hope is to use the Super Time Machine to evade the Temporal Seam before their enemy becomes unstoppable![/h3]

[previewyoutube=jWSefHXCJY4;full][/previewyoutube]
A [b][url=https://bnent.eu/DBTBcnt]Closed Network Test[/url][/b] will be held on all platforms on [i][b]August 6 and 7[/b][/i] and players can register [url=https://bnent.eu/DBTBcnt][b]here[/b][/url]. During this CNT, [b]Frieza[/b], the newly announced Raider, and [b]Cell[/b] will be available to play. [b]Avatar[/b], [b]Oolong Survivor Skin[/b] and [b]Bulma Survivor Skin[/b] will also be available to play as Survivors.
The CNT will be playable at the following times:
[list][*] [b]Session 1[/b]: 8/5 (Fri) 7:00PM - 11:00PM PDT / 8/6 (Sat) 2:00AM - 6:00AM UTC / 8/6 (Sat) 4:00AM - 8:00AM CEST
[*] [b]Session 2[/b]: 8/6 (Sat) 5:00AM - 9:00AM PDT / 8/6 (Sat) 12:00PM - 4:00PM UTC / 8/6 (Sat) 2:00PM - 6:00PM CEST
[*] [b]Session 3[/b]: 8/6 (Sat) 11:00AM - 3:00PM PDT / 8/6 (Sat) 6:00PM - 10:00PM UTC / 8/6 (Sat) 8:00PM - 12:00AM CEST
[*] [b]Session 4[/b]: 8/6 (Sat) 7:00PM - 11:00PM PDT / 8/7 (Sun) 2:00AM - 6:00AM UTC / 8/7 (Sun) 4:00AM - 8:00AM CEST[/list]An [b]Open Beta Test[/b] will be organized at a later date with more details to be announced soon. Details for digital preorders will be announced at a later date.

[h3][b]Prepare to enter the Temporal Seam![/b][/h3]

notes.content:

[h3]How to Participate:[/h3]
- [b]Europe[/b]: [url=https://bnent.eu/DBTB_BETA]Register[/url]
- [b]North America[/b]: [url=fcld.ly/dbtb_beta_us]Register[/url]
- [b]Southeast Asia[/b]: [url=https://dbas.bn-ent.net/cbt/en/]Register[/url] (Southeast Asia includes the following countries: Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Macau, Brunei, Cambodia, Laos, Mongolia, Myanmar, Timor-Leste)

To [b]prepare yourself for the closed beta test[/b], please feel free to watch the newly released [b]DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS system trailer[/b]. The video covers all of the [b]game's rules and gameplay elements[/b], as well as [b]tips for playing as the raider or as a survivor[/b].
[previewyoutube=rUUMwD3NrnE;full][/previewyoutube]
Taking place in the [b]DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE universe[/b], DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS allows you to [b]play as one of the iconic villains of the franchise, the “Raider”[/b], or as one of [b]seven “survivors,” regular people who lack super powers[/b]. DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS is the [b]ultimate survival game[/b] between an iconic Dragon Ball villain and seven ordinary people. 

[h3][b]Which role will you choose to play?[/b][/h3]

The [b]raider’s goal is to wipe out all the survivors[/b], and the [b]raider has the clear advantage here[/b]. Additionally, the raider can gradually [b]evolve into his final form[/b] as he meets certain conditions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/2b30602be922c99610b9a346c86a9f1bd28390a8.png[/img]

[b]Escape from the temporal seam using the super time machine![/b] The survivors will need to place the [b]power keys[/b] and [b]protect the startup system[/b] in order to escape.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/c9f9e81475481b5cb865cefab5111ffa2a543511.png[/img]

On the other hand, the raider will need to [b]destroy the startup system to prevent the survivors from getting away[/b]. But even if the survivors fail to protect the startup system, they can still escape using a [b]regular time machine[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/39e1744e92cdbfc79b2ad5c7e811d90bf2f7ae6b.png[/img]

The [b]survivors' goal is to escape from the temporal seam[/b] while avoiding the raider. [b]Work together with your friends to survive[/b] and [b]escape using the super time machine[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/55de00e1b0cbd836deca039d5351b859847e179a.png[/img]

Survivors can use [b]various items on the field[/b] to avoid encountering the raider.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/7ad0a36cbbb5ee986bf2ecb64e1f5ff0a15bf88e.png[/img]

[b]Blind the raider with a Solar Flare! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/76ee2eb2249fcdb95e21e370dfc35a522a2109d4.png[/img]

Use the [b]Dragon Radar to find the Dragon Balls[/b]! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/cbefb64753e7cd93ab303918ee05028104ebbb3e.png[/img]

[b]Transform using Dragon Change![/b] Utilize [b]transpheres to gain super warrior abilities[/b] for a [b]limited period of time[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/63010748bb3c931decac634a3acdbaf8fe203fa5.png[/img]

If you get a [b]survivor skin[/b], you can [b]transform and use the skills of that survivor[/b]. Use [b]special abilities to resist the raider![/b] Those abilities aren't just Super Attacks either. [b]Oolong[/b] can transform into [b]various objects[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41553352/ba3cbd4f53b3c2d296ddd9dc3329c839e3021a30.png[/img]

Experience the [b]overwhelming power difference[/b] in the [b]ultimate asymmetrical battle with DRAGON BALL: THE BREAKERS! [/b]

[h3][b]Break out or break down![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276760/DRAGON_BALL_THE_BREAKERS/
